BoatCapacity.definition: Number of ducks a boat can carry per trip

CanoeCapacity.definition: Number of ducks a canoe can carry per trip

BoatTripTime.definition: Time in minutes per boat trip

CanoeTripTime.definition: Time in minutes per canoe trip

MaxBoatTrips.definition: Maximum number of boat trips allowed

MinCanoeTripFraction.definition: Minimum fraction of trips that must be by canoe

MinDucks.definition: Minimum number of ducks to be transported to shore
